summaries.en: A police officer in Jeju, accused of falsely closing the missing person case of Jang Miran, has been emergency arrested after it was revealed he also falsely closed another missing person case, while the search for Jang Miran continues.
summaries.zh: 一名涉嫌虚假结案济州失踪者张美兰案件的警察，因被揭露也虚假结案了另一起失踪案件而被紧急逮捕，目前对张美兰的搜寻仍在继续。
